about: Figure-QA v2 candidates. Every question asks for an ARBITRARY value - one that could have been otherwise - with near-miss distractors drawn from the same figure, because v1 showed that questions about what a figure *depicts* are mostly answerable from convention (closed-book scored 8/15). Candidates are screened, not trusted: see v2-admitted.json.
screening: A candidate is ADMITTED only if the full-optical arm gets it RIGHT (ground truth is sound and the page supports it) AND the closed-book arm gets it WRONG (not reachable by convention) AND the text-only arm gets it WRONG (not in the whole-document markdown, as prose or as loose tokens).
